preconditions.description: The input integer x must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if x == 1 else any(1 <= a <= x and 1 <= b <= x and a % b == 0 and a * b > x and a // b < x for a in range(1, x + 1) for b in range(1, a + 1))
postconditions.description: If x is 1, output '-1'; otherwise, output two integers a and b that satisfy the conditions.
